sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Game is over but still on level 1. Let me check the current state.
print(f"Step: {current_frame.step}")
print(f"Level: {current_frame.level}")
print(f"Last action result: {last_action_result}")

# Check if we can still take actions
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']

# Find character
char_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'b' and n['pixels'] <= 10]
print(f"\nCharacter nodes: {len(char_nodes)}")
for cn in char_nodes:
    print(f"  boundary={cn['boundary']}, pixels={cn['pixels']}")

# Find green blocks
green_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N' and n['pixels'] > 5]
print(f"\nGreen blocks: {len(green_nodes)}")
for gn in green_nodes:
    b = gn['boundary']
    center_r = sum(p[0] for p in b) // len(b)
    center_c = sum(p[1] for p in b) // len(b)
    print(f"  center~({center_r}, {center_c})")

# Check purple bar
purple_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'p']
print(f"\nPurple objects: {len(purple_nodes)}")
for pn in purple_nodes:
    print(f"  pixels={pn['pixels']}, boundary={pn['boundary']}")

# Try an action to see if game is truly over
result = action(['LEFT'])
print(f"\nAfter LEFT: done={last_action_result.get('done')}, game_over={last_action_result.get('game_over')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
